svg.title: Dense Runtime
svg.desc: Overall solver runtime in seconds for four dense face sequences with 28,887 points each. Ours, OPM, and TSM. Shared logarithmic axis. Main paper Table 5, page 7; Ours totals match supplementary Table 14. Runtime implementations and hardware vary.
